bias_findings.finding: The interface never names the people served or affected coastal communities; community impact (30% of rubric) rests entirely on the spoken demo.
English-only interface in a majority-Spanish-speaking metro; acknowledged in DEMO_STORY as future outreach work. Acceptable for a researcher/planner prototype; do not claim community reach.
HANDOFF form-DNA language 'neo-tribal/cybersigilism' is not on the site; if used in the spoken pitch it invites an appropriation reading. Human presentation choice.

criteria.source: Decision at center of demo: "Given recent Miami-area observations and an illustrative energy-demand scenario, what can we responsibly conclude about a proposed underwater network, and what evidence/action is required next?"
criteria.criterion: Proxy logic: 'responsibly conclude' → the seven frozen demo-path steps run end-to-end in the running build because that path is the only mechanism that produces the conclusion. Pass = each step observed working.
criteria.evidence: S1 NODAL logo + task line (Dashboard.tsx:76); S2 strip+panel 30.4 °C / 0.434 m with observed 18:24 UTC and FETCHED FROM NOAA; S3 RIDGE_01/CANYON_01/RIDGE_02/CANYON_02 selected; S4 demand 60→120; S5 +20→−40 kW with 5 UNKNOWN gaps; S6 two real Gemma responses (8.2 s each); S7 action switched COMMISSION-LOCAL-STUDIES → MITIGATE-SHORTFALL.
criteria.falsifier: A step that errors, shows nothing, or needs a manual workaround; walked the path in the browser at 1440x900 on both builds.

criteria.source: People served: Miami-area marine researchers, coastal resilience teams, and environmental/infrastructure planners screening proposed interventions. (Demo 0:00–0:20: Miami environmental accountability problem, intended researchers/planners.)
criteria.criterion: Proxy logic: 'two-minute comprehension of the problem' → the first viewport names the intended users, Miami, and the accountability problem in on-screen copy, because a judge reads the header before anything else.
criteria.evidence: First viewport (1280x720, 1440x900) shows the task line, the 'Not an operating data center…' disclaimer and the aspiration motto (Dashboard.tsx:76-80). No mention of the users, of Miami (the strip says 'Virginia Key · 8723214'), or of 'environmental accountability precedes deployment'; the accountability line sits in the footer (Dashboard.tsx:153).
criteria.falsifier: Header copy with no audience, place or problem; read the rendered header and strip text at 1280x720 and 1440x900.

criteria.source: Calculation: netPowerKw = simulatedGenerationKw - simulatedDemandKw. (User brief: check positive/zero/negative power balances.)
criteria.criterion: Rendered net power equals generation minus demand for positive, zero, negative and extreme inputs, with Unicode minus and status text.
criteria.evidence: 60/80 → '+20 kW SURPLUS'; 80/80 → '0 kW ZERO MARGIN'; 120/80 → '−40 kW ▼ SHORTFALL'; 200/0 → '−200 kW ▼ SHORTFALL'; NET pill mirrored each (Dashboard.tsx:105-107). scenario.test.ts covers the same.
criteria.falsifier: Wrong sign/magnitude, hyphen-minus, or a status label disagreeing with the number; set sliders and read .net and the NET pill.

criteria.source: Any battery-runtime estimate uses availableBatteryEnergyKWh / max(0, -netPowerKw) and only when there is a shortfall; expose assumptions
criteria.criterion: Runtime shows kWh ÷ shortfall during shortfall, UNKNOWN when the battery is off, and is hidden in surplus.
criteria.evidence: 150 kWh at −40 kW → '3.75 h (optional, ignores losses)'; battery unchecked → 'Battery capacity is not set, so runtime is UNKNOWN' and field disabled; 0 kWh → '0 h'; surplus (60/80) → no runtime line. See B-01/B-02 for input-handling bugs.
criteria.falsifier: Runtime in surplus, infinity, or a number when battery is off; toggled checkbox and values during shortfall and surplus.

Energy state as text '▼ SHORTFALL'/'SURPLUS'/'ZERO MARGIN'; freshness as text; selection via aria-pressed, inset bar and dashed SVG outline. Shortfall cable amber is redundant with the NET pill text.

criteria.source: Show recent NOAA observations with timestamps, units, original source, and fetched/cached/error state. … Preserve timestamp, units, sensor station ID, source URL
criteria.criterion: Each offered product card shows value+unit, observed time (UTC and Miami local), station context, source link and retrieval state, and its value equals NOAA's raw record.
criteria.evidence: /api/noaa 18:26Z: water_temperature 30.4 °C (raw v '30.4'), water_level 0.441 m MLLW q=p (raw '0.441'), wind 6.0/7.0 m/s 165° SSE (raw s/g/d), air_temperature 29.9 °C, air_pressure 1016.4 mb — all observed 18:18Z. Direct NOAA datagetter returned identical records for water_temperature and water_level. Cards show 'Observed … UTC · … EDT', 'Fetched from NOAA', per-product 'NOAA source ↗' (NoaaPanel.tsx:74-100).
criteria.falsifier: A value differing from NOAA, a missing unit/time, or a card without source; compared parsed vs raw vs direct NOAA.

criteria.source: Fallback observations must be accurately labeled cached with original observation time … Freshness: FETCHED FROM NOAA / CACHED / OLD / UNAVAILABLE / FETCH ERROR … missing value '—' + reason, never zero
criteria.criterion: Each freshness state renders its honest label in the top strip and the panel, keeps original times, and never substitutes a numeric value for missing data.
criteria.evidence: Live: 'FETCHED FROM NOAA'; currents '— unavailable … none is assumed' (NOAA 'Wrong Station ID'). Client-side stubbed responses (server untouched): cached → 'CACHED — NOT LIVE' + per-value '· CACHED' + original 18:24Z; old → 'FETCHED FROM NOAA · OBSERVATION OLD' + 'OLD (75 min)'; unavailable → strip '— unavailable', banner 'Regional context is UNKNOWN', NODAL-OBS-001 → UNKNOWN; fetch error/HTTP 500 → 'REFRESH FAILED — PREVIOUS READINGS' with original observed time. Strip and panel share freshness() (NoaaPanel.tsx:30-49).
criteria.falsifier: Strip and panel disagreeing, an advanced timestamp, or a zero in place of missing data; rendered each state and read both surfaces.

criteria.source: DD-07: Add freshness on a separate axis … Failure condition: Fresh fetch hides an old observation. DESIGN_SYSTEM: Retrieval now does not mean observation now.
criteria.criterion: The relative-age readout and OLD flag stay true while the page remains open.
criteria.evidence: ageMinutes/stale are computed once on the server at response time (noaa.server.ts:201) and the client fetches NOAA only on mount/Refresh (Dashboard.tsx:56). Observed: at ~18:31Z a card still read '10 min old · retrieved 18:27' for an 18:18Z observation (actual 13 min). A page opened an hour before the demo keeps 'FETCHED FROM NOAA · N min old' and never flips to OLD. Absolute observation times stay correct.
criteria.falsifier: A relative age that does not advance with wall-clock time; compared displayed age to clock and read the code path.

criteria.source: Send the real structured assessment summary to Gemma 4 through Gemini API; display its grounded explanation if configured. (User: verify the explanation corresponds to the current scenario … and acknowledges uncertainty.)
criteria.criterion: A real request returns an explanation whose simulated numbers, allocation, action and uncertainty match the assessment JSON for that scenario.
criteria.evidence: Run 1 (RIDGE_01 60/80/150, 18:29Z): '+20 kW', '21 kW', action COMMISSION-LOCAL-STUDIES, five gaps listed, 'Ecological suitability remains undetermined', cites real rule IDs. Run 2 (120/80/150): '−40 kW', '42 kW', '3.75 hours', MITIGATE-SHORTFALL, 'Energy results do not imply environmental safety [NODAL-ENV-000]'. Both report 'uncertainty section: present; cites rule IDs: yes'. No invented thresholds.
criteria.falsifier: A number, action or ID not in the payload, or a safety/suitability claim; compared text to 'Exact JSON sent to Gemma'.

criteria.source: Feed it verified assessment JSON and instruct: don't invent observations … (User: verify the explanation … distinguishes observations from assumptions.)
criteria.criterion: Observed values quoted in the explanation equal the observations displayed on screen, or the explanation states the observation time it used.
criteria.evidence: Both runs said 'water level of 0.434 m' while strip and panel showed 0.441 m observed 18:18Z. The server rebuilt NOAA for the request (gemma.server.ts:58 getNoaa(false), 60 s cache) and sent 18:24Z data; the client panel had not refreshed. The explanation gives no observation time and drops the MLLW datum. Values are real, not invented, but the explanation and the screen disagree.
criteria.falsifier: Explanation numbers differing from the on-screen observation without a stated time; compared payload observedAtUtc with strip text.

criteria.source: User brief §4: Check loading, failure, unavailable, and outdated-response states.
criteria.criterion: Loading, model failure, no-key unavailable, route error and outdated states each render truthful text and never show a generated-looking paragraph that was not generated.
criteria.evidence: Live: loading 'Asking Gemma 4…' button disabled + 'Sending the structured assessment JSON…'; outdated banner after 60→120 kW. Stubbed client responses: route error 'FAILED — could not reach this app's explain route'; unavailable 'UNAVAILABLE — Gemma 4 was not called'; quota 'FAILED — Quota / rate limit (HTTP 429) … No explanation was generated.' Fallback text labelled 'not AI'. See B-03 for ordering copy bug.

Limit: response modelVersion is not captured (B-06).

criteria.source: prefers-reduced-motion: remove atmosphere, camera interpolation and decorative transitions; preserve direct state updates.

criteria.evidence: globals.css:91 disables .nv-wave animation and transitions; globals.css:161 stops the spinner. No JS animation. Media-feature emulation was unavailable in the browser pane, so this is code-read evidence only.

criteria.source: Run production build, verify flow manually (Gate 4). (User: run relevant existing tests and type checks.)
criteria.criterion: Unit tests, typecheck and production build pass on the audited source.
criteria.evidence: Isolated copy in scratchpad (no writes to web/, running server untouched): vitest 19/19 pass; tsc --noEmit exit 0; next build compiled, TypeScript finished, 3/3 static pages — on both snapshot sources. First isolated build attempt failed only because Turbopack rejects a symlinked node_modules; re-run with an APFS clone passed.
criteria.falsifier: A failing test, type error or build error; ran each command and read output.

criteria.source: Final NODAL logo | Lucho | Temporary typographic placeholder clearly identified | Human supplies and approves file/proportions
criteria.criterion: The header shows either a labelled placeholder or the human-approved logo file.
criteria.evidence: Snapshot 2 replaced the placeholder with public/brand/nodal-white.svg (alt 'NODAL'); Wordmark.tsx and README state it was supplied by the designer. The assayer has no record of Lucho's approval of this file or its proportions.
criteria.falsifier: An unlabelled improvised mark; inspected Wordmark.tsx and the rendered header.

criteria.source: User brief §1: Identify where terminology or hierarchy interrupts that journey. ADD voice: prefer 'simulated shortfall,' 'regional observation,' 'site suitability undetermined.'
criteria.criterion: Proxy logic: comprehension → the primary reading path uses plain-language labels and moves developer identifiers into disclosures.
criteria.evidence: Main path shows 'Rules triggered: NODAL-PWR-001 · … · verdict NODAL-VERDICT-001' between action and suitability (AssessmentPanel.tsx:40-44), the action ID in the action header (line 35), camelCase formula 'netPowerKw = simulatedGenerationKw − simulatedDemandKw', and 'Assessment f24c5e8e'. Plain labels otherwise good.
criteria.falsifier: Machine identifiers in the main reading path; read the rendered assessment panel.

criteria.source: README with team, build date, how to run, exact data URLs and AI model ID/terms, limitations, tech stack, track. Public GitHub repo and suitable license
criteria.criterion: README content is present and accurate, a LICENSE exists, and the project is in a repository.
criteria.evidence: web/README.md has track, build date, model ID/terms, data URLs, limitations and an honest Gemma checkbox. No LICENSE file in the project (find depth 3) and no .git directory; README:95,105 leave both to the human.
criteria.falsifier: Missing README sections, LICENSE or repo; read README and searched the tree.
